note_en: Stories OCMS36.1-36.5 only mention browse, edit, test send, QR/PDF and save/schedule. The Create Template screen (routes create-template/sms|email|letter), the POST templatestore endpoint and the name validation (uppercase letters/digits/underscore, must end with _SMS/_EMAIL/_LETTER and match the type) are built and in use (OCMS-SR-2026-163: a user created a test template in Production through this screen). There is no delete feature at any layer. Not counted under any story in this chunk.
